sources.title: Michelin Guide Belgium & Luxembourg 2026 — Cuines 33 promoted to two stars
sources.claim: Cuines 33 promoted to two MICHELIN Stars in the 2026 Belgium & Luxembourg guide.

sources.title: Cuines 33 — MICHELIN Guide listing
sources.claim: Smedenstraat 33, counter-only, 16 seats.

sources.title: Cuines 33 — Yelp
sources.claim: Smedenstraat 33, 8300 Knokke-Heist.

sources.title: Knokke train station
sources.claim: Knokke station at Maurice Lippensplein 25 — opens onto Smedenstraat.

sources.title: Knokke-Heist to Bruges by train
sources.claim: Direct trains hourly Knokke-Heist→Bruges, ~17 min, €5–8.

sources.title: Hotel Prins Boudewijn
sources.claim: City-centre 3-star opposite market square; rooftop terrace; ~360 m from Cuines 33.

sources.title: La Réserve Resort Knokke-Heist
sources.claim: 5-star superior at Elizabetlaan 160, opposite Knokke casino; ~1.03 km from Cuines 33.

sources.title: La Réserve — MICHELIN Guide hotels
sources.claim: Reopened 2023 after Glenn Sestig overhaul; 37 rooms; 1930s grandeur with eucalyptus, onyx, Art Deco.

sources.title: Hotel Britannia Knokke
sources.claim: 36 rooms in a 1928 Anglo-Norman villa, fully renovated 2022; private parking €30/day; ~1.07 km from Cuines 33.

sources.title: Manoir du Dragon
sources.claim: Albertlaan 73; 1927 manor reborn as 4-star boutique; adjacent to Royal Zoute golf; ~690 m from Cuines 33.

sources.title: Strandhotel Cadzand-Bad
sources.claim: Piet Boon-designed dune hotel; Auping beds; ~17 min taxi each way from Knokke.

sources.title: Bruges canal boats
sources.claim: Five licensed operators, identical 30-min canal tours, fixed price.

sources.title: Bruges Boat Tour
sources.claim: Daily 10:00–17:30 from 13 Feb to 30 Dec 2026; €15 adult, €9 child 4–11, under-4s free.

sources.title: Musea Brugge — BRUSK
sources.claim: New BRUSK gallery opens 8 May 2026.

sources.title: Belfort van Brugge
sources.claim: Belfry climb (366 steps) requires timed-entry pre-booking, especially in peak season.

sources.title: Groeningemuseum
sources.claim: Tue–Sun 09:30–17:00, closed Mon; €12 adult, €10 under-26, free under-16.

sources.title: Zwin Nature Park
sources.claim: Graaf Léon Lippensdreef 8, Knokke-Heist; €12 online/€14 on site; summer 10–18 daily.

sources.title: Zwin — discover the park
sources.claim: Day ticket: bird-migration exhibition, cabin trail, observation centre, panorama tower, Zwin Plain.

sources.title: Het Zwin — Birdingplaces
sources.claim: Over 300 bird species recorded; autumn migration Aug–Nov.

sources.title: Damse Vaart cycling — Visit Bruges
sources.claim: Flat, well-paved 38 km cycle path Bruges→Knokke-Heist via Damme, poplar-lined towpath.

sources.title: Damse Vaart canal
sources.claim: 15 km canal Sluis (NL)–Bruges; Damme ~5 km from Bruges.

sources.title: Knokke-Heist polders cycle path
sources.claim: New 4 m semi-paved path on Internationale Zwindijk links Knokke-Heist to Cadzand.

sources.title: Restaurant Demain — Story
sources.claim: One-star Demain (successor to Pure C) leaves Strandhotel Cadzand on 31 May 2026.

sources.title: Pure C — Wikipedia
sources.claim: Pure C, the previous design-restaurant resident at Strandhotel Cadzand, closed.

sources.title: Grand Casino Knokke — renovation
sources.claim: Casino Knokke closes for full renovation early 2026 through ~2032.

sources.title: Knokke Casino — Wikipedia
sources.claim: Magritte's 360° mural 'The Enchanted Domain' (8 panels, ~70 m × 7 m, 1953) inside the casino.

sources.title: NL extends border checks to mid-2026
sources.claim: Non-systematic Marechaussee checks at the Belgian border extended into mid-2026.

sources.title: Kusttram — De Lijn
sources.claim: 67 km tram line, 65+ stops, world's longest; end-to-end ~2.5 h.

sources.title: Kusttram day pass
sources.claim: €9 adult / €4.50 child for 24h; every 10–20 min by day; later evening service summer 2026.

sources.title: Het Zoute district
sources.claim: Het Zoute: chic eastern Knokke — villas, golf, top restaurants, high-end boutiques.

sources.title: EUSIPCO 2026
sources.claim: 34th European Signal Processing Conference, 31 Aug–4 Sep 2026, Concertgebouw Brugge.

sources.title: Howest Tech BBQ 2026
sources.claim: Thu 25 June 2026 18:00 at Howest Rijselstraat 5, Brugge; €19 BBQ ticket; ransomware-in-healthcare talk.

sources.title: Knokke-Heist events calendar
sources.claim: Knokke-Heist hosts no IT or developer conferences.

sources.title: Knokke-Heist cycling routes
sources.claim: 52 km Maerlantroute through peatlands; Route East (10 km) around Knokke; sea dyke longest in town.

sources.title: Zwin walking trail — Hotel St Pol
sources.claim: 13.3 km trail with 9.2 km loop option; outside the paid Zwin park.

sources.title: Church of Our Lady — Bruges
sources.claim: Michelangelo's Madonna and Child — the only Michelangelo sculpture to have left Italy in his lifetime.
